preconditions.description: The length of S is between 1 and 10^5
The length of pat is between 1 and the length of S

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(index, int) for index in result)
all(1 <= index <= len(S) for index in result)
postconditions.description: Each index is a 1-based index within S

postconditions.expression: result == [i + 1 for i in range(len(S)) if S[i:i+len(pat)] == pat]
postconditions.description: The result contains the 1-based starting indices of all occurrences of pat in S

postconditions.expression: result == [] if pat not in S else result
postconditions.description: The result is an empty list if pat is not a substring of S, otherwise it contains the indices
